messages:
Jared Park: quick heads-up 60s sync: AcmeHW + CloudX want to publish a bundled marketplace image that includes an open checkpoint. They asked us to provide an attested model bundle and a short ops playbook.
Nina Gomez: cool. do we know which license the checkpoint uses? that's the gating issue for marketplace redistribution.
Jared Park: partner says "OpenWeights v2 (permissive)" but we need to verify upstream source and provenance. They also want a signed SBOM-like manifest and container signature.
Priya Reddy: ops caveat: if we ship a quantized runtime artifact, we must label it clearly and include a non-quantized reference for compliance/audits. Also need guidance for customers on runtime flags to avoid silent precision changes.
SecurityBot: Recommended manifest fields:
```
name: model-name
version: 2026-02-14
origin: https://models.example.org/model-name
weights_sha256: <hex>
license: Apache-2.0
quantized: true
quantization_profile: int8-dynamic
signature: <sig-base64>
```
Signed by Redwood key. Include link to verification tool.
Nina Gomez: for marketplace listing copy: we should state "Redwood-verified provenance" and include a short bullet "Includes provenance.json and verification steps". Keep any performance claims conservative.
LegalBot:Checklist for go/no-go:
- attach upstream license text (must allow redistribution)
- confirm no third-party data restrictions in weights
- indemnity/representations: partners must warrant they have the right to redistribute
- export control: confirm ECCN/USG conditions for the combined artifact
If any item fails, we can't be a signatory on the listing.
Jared Park: GTM asked about SKU: proposal: free VM image for trial + optional paid support plan (per-seat or per-deployment). If CloudX wants revenue share, that's a separate commercial addendum.
Priya Reddy: tech delivery plan:
1) produce attested bundle (weights + provenance.json + signature)
2) build OCI image with runtime and a small smoke test binary
3) publish test harness (one REST call + expected digest)
4) provide minimal rollback: stub image that returns 503 and points to support contact

I'll prepare the packaging spec and a sample verification script (`verify_model.sh`).
Nina Gomez: timeline ask from AcmeHW: 2-week target to listing. Legal will need at least 72h. Security needs 48h for manifest review. Ops needs a week to build/test the images.
LegalBot: please upload the upstream license and sample weights checksum. We'll review and return redlines within 72 hours. If commercial redistribution is unclear, request a written grant from the upstream.
Jared Park: note for CloudX marketplace: require that all marketplace consumers must accept a TOS that includes attribution and prohibits re-redistribution without express permission. CloudX agreed in principle but wants the exact wording.
Priya Reddy: small technical note: add a CI check that verifies the attestation signature before publishing the image to the marketplace CI pipeline. Keeps downstream integrity.
SecurityBot: Also recommend container signing (cosign) and an automated alarm if an image digest in marketplace changes.
Nina Gomez: I'll draft the listing copy + the minimal announcement language. No joint press until legal signs off on claim language and partner marketing review is complete.
Jared Park: great, will collect artifacts and upload here. tagging: @LegalBot @SecurityBot for follow-ups.
